page.title: Awesome AI
page.intro: Official links for AI tools, grouped by what they do.

tools.chatgpt: Draft and revise text, brainstorm ideas, and ask follow-up questions.
tools.claude: Read through a long document or revise a draft from detailed feedback.
tools.gemini: Ask questions about text and images or turn notes into a first draft.
tools.kimi: Upload a document and ask Kimi to pull out the details you need.
tools.deepseek: A chat assistant for working through reasoning problems and discussing uploaded documents.
tools.qwen-chat: Ask questions about text and images, or draft content in multiple languages.
tools.copilot: Get inline code suggestions and ask questions inside your editor.
tools.cursor: An editor that can find its way around your codebase and make changes across several files.
tools.continue: A configurable coding assistant that lets you bring your own model.
tools.codex: Ask for a code change and have Codex run the project checks from your terminal.
tools.claude-code: Inspect a repo, edit files, and run tests from a terminal chat.
tools.antigravity: Use coding agents across an editor, terminal, and browser to build and verify changes.
tools.opencode: An open-source terminal coding agent with a choice of model providers.
tools.v0: Start with a prompt or mockup, then refine the web interface in a live preview.
tools.lovable: Describe the web app you want to build, then publish it from Lovable.
tools.bolt: Build and run a full-stack web app without leaving the browser.
tools.perplexity: Search the web and check the answer against the linked sources.
tools.notebooklm: Give it your own sources and ask questions or turn them into study notes.
tools.elicit: Find papers and put their findings side by side in a table.
tools.exa: Retrieve relevant web pages and page text through a search API.
tools.tavily: Add web search and page extraction to agents and research workflows.
tools.consensus: Find answers in peer-reviewed papers and use the citations to check the original studies.
tools.firefly: Generate image concepts and fill or replace selected areas of an image.
tools.ideogram: An image generator for posters and other graphics that need text.
tools.comfyui: Build reusable image generation workflows with a node editor.
tools.recraft: Make and edit vector graphics such as icons and illustrations.
tools.figma-make: Start with a prompt or a Figma design and turn it into a clickable prototype.
tools.flux: Generate and edit images with Black Forest Labs models via an API.
tools.kite: Design screens with your team while AI agents like Claude or Cursor draw editable layers in the same file over MCP.
tools.whisper: Turn a recording into text locally with an open-source speech model.
tools.elevenlabs: Turn scripts into spoken narration and produce dubbed audio.
tools.runway: Generate short video clips from text prompts or still images.
tools.kling: Make a clip from text or a still image, with references to guide the motion.
tools.veo: Generate video with sound from a prompt or reference image.
tools.descript: Edit a transcript to cut the corresponding audio or video.
tools.notion: Summarize notes and draft documents within your Notion workspace.
tools.zapier: Add steps that classify or summarize text to automations across apps.
tools.n8n: Connect apps, APIs, and language models in a visual workflow editor.
tools.dify: Build an AI app that can look up information in your own knowledge base.
tools.flowise: Wire up models and tools on a canvas to build an agent.
tools.browser-use: A Python library for browser tasks such as reading pages and filling out forms.
tools.manus: Hand off web research and get the findings back as a report.
